::: {#exr-miller-taylor-x-log-x}
#### Taylor expansion of $x \log x$

Adapted from @problifesavercalc, Question 1.1.25.

Find the first three terms (up to degree 2) of the Taylor series for

$$f(x) = x\log x$$

at $x_0 = 1$.
:::

::: {#sol-miller-taylor-x-log-x}
Evaluate derivatives at $x_0 = 1$:

$$\ba
f(1) &= 1 \log 1 = 0
\\
f'(x) &= \log x + 1 \implies f'(1) = 0 + 1 = 1
\\
f''(x) &= \frac{1}{x} \implies f''(1) = 1
\ea$$

Therefore:

$$P_2(x) = f(1) + f'(1)(x - 1) + \frac{f''(1)}{2!}(x - 1)^2 = (x - 1) + \frac{1}{2}(x - 1)^2$$
:::
